provenance.geometry, mass, com: the car's shared specification values v2 and the owner model's digest (derived_geometry)
provenance.mass split and sprung inertia: car_parts_manifest.json: 120 parts; unsprung parts and their fractions in params.UNSPRUNG; a part's own inertia = uniform box of its bounding box (OWN_BOX_MM for battery, motor, kit speed controller, servo)
provenance.motor_nameplate: 540-size brushed motor of the owner's model (can 35.7 x 54.5 mm, 160 g); electrical values = the page values the series' stage 01 world gives this car's motor (the 160 g reference motor), adopted so that the car is one car across the series; no shared key
provenance.battery: 6-cell NiMH 7.2 V of the owner's model (digest, stage 01 electrical identity); cell resistance = stage 01's page value of the 320 g reference pack; voltage held at the nominal 7.2 V (no state of charge)
provenance.controller: the deck motor controller board is the speed controller; 40 A limit = stage 01's page value of the 40 g reference board; the speed loop runs at the physics rate; bandwidth 5 Hz on the rolling car (the drive model's choice)
provenance.drivetrain: TT-01 layout (front and rear differentials, one propeller shaft); final drive 61/19 x 39/15 = 8.3474 (spec_values); efficiency 0.90 (estimate: spur, two bevel stages, CVDs); rotor inertia 3e-6 kg m2 (estimate: 540 armature, 45 g at 11.5 mm); differential carrier 6.4e-6 kg m2 each (32 g at 20 mm)
provenance.wheel inertia: rim + tyre 23.7 g as a ring of radii 32.9 / 20 mm plus axle, hex and nut; estimate
provenance.suspension: wheel rate 1000 N/m per corner (estimate for a 1/10 touring car: 8 Hz ride, 4 degrees roll at 1 g); damping ratio about 0.5; travel +10 / -7 mm (estimate); slide joints instead of double wishbones
provenance.steering: lock 0.4189 rad and 3.2 rad/s (the car's specification values, the owner's decision of 2026-11-14); servo = rate limit then a first-order lag of 0.05 s (the drive model's estimate for an analog standard servo: proportional band of about 0.16 rad at 3.2 rad/s; the ForzaETH value 0.158 s lumps its software smoother and is compared in the record); stall torque 0.35 N m (standard servo 3.2 kg cm); 100 % Ackermann by a quartic polycoef (the CAD's linkage gives about 26 %)
provenance.resistance: rolling resistance 0.015 x load as dry friction on the spin joints; drag area Cd A 0.018 m2 (no body shell, 185 mm wide); estimates
provenance.tyre.cone: MuJoCo elliptic cone, condim 3, friction = grip_at under the wheel at every physics step through explicit tyre x floor contact pairs
provenance.tyre.slip_angle: cone plus a lateral layer: a vertical pivot 20 mm ahead of the contact with a spring k = C_S N0 e, so that F_y = C_S N0 alpha below the limit and the lag is a relaxation length of 20 mm; C_S = the platform single-track values 4.718 / 5.4562 per rad (f1tenth_gym); past the limit the pair friction falls with the sliding angle to 0.8 of the grip at 0.3 rad
provenance.hull: boxes from the part bounding boxes of car_parts_manifest.json, kept clear of the tyres' swept volume at full lock (test_s1_hull)
provenance.lidar_targets: As the contract says (the same as the contract's stub car)
provenance.tyre.contact: tyre x floor pairs: condim 3, solref 0.01 s (4 physics steps; 0.005 s let light sliding wheels lose contact every few steps), solreffriction 0 0 = the normal solref (a softer friction solref adds a false lateral slip of yaw rate x speed / b at every rolling wheel: MuJoCo leaves J-dot q-dot out of the constraint; measured 17 mm/s against 17.9 predicted at b = 42 1/s); single-point ellipsoid tyre r x w/2 x r (the cylinder's two edge contacts gave a Coulomb scrub torque of about 0.06 N m per tyre in tight turns)
provenance.drivetrain.centre: the propeller shaft locks the front axle's mean spin to the rear's; with friction-cone tyres a hard lock forces sliding in every corner (measured: chatter of the light wheels at 200 Hz); modelled as the tendon `centre` with damping C_k N_series r^2 / max(v, v_lo), the longitudinal slip stiffness real tyres take the mismatch with (C_k = 15 per unit slip, estimate); v_lo from c_max dt / J_centre = 1 (numerical: c dt / J = 5 diverged at launch on grip 0.15 at 2.5 ms)
provenance.tyre.slip_angle.load: pivot stiffness C_S N(t) e with N(t) = suspension force + unsprung weight, filtered 10 ms (load-proportional cornering stiffness; a constant stiffness saturated the unloaded inner tyre at 0.66 g on grip 1.0)
provenance.drivetrain.inertia: rotor 3e-6 kg m2 x 8.3474^2 plus two differential carriers, a quarter on each spin joint's armature (MuJoCo 3.14 puts a fixed tendon's armature only on the mass matrix diagonal for joints in different branches, measured: a tendon armature would load the driving mode 2.2x)
